'''6100 BBY''' or '''6100<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Before the Battle of Yavin''' was a [[Standard year/Legends|standard year]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> in the [[Manderon Period]]<ref name="Era" /> that was part of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]].<ref name="NEC" /> By 6100 BBY, the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] had been colonized because of its active geothermal activity, as well as its agreeable climate.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
6100 BBY was created for [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]'s [[2009]] book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA" />
